subject: Satellite research enclave — accelerated renewal & capacity add
related_account: University of Oxford - AI Research Lab
content:
Message 1
From: Elena Martín <elena.martin@uni-ox.ac.uk>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal timeline and isolated satellite enclave for campus cluster

Hi Aditya,

Hope you’re well — our PI board confirmed funding for the next 18 months but the grant requires that the new compute for the AI Lab be in a physically isolated environment on our campus network. We currently have Redwood private VPC + on-prem pilot in scope and would like to accelerate the renewal/expansion so we can onboard the first satellite enclave before the spring semester (target: staging by 2027-01-20).

Can you share a high-level plan for:
- Standup timeline for a single on-prem satellite (3x A100 equiv)
- Changes to contract term (we may need 18-months vs our current 12)
- Any compliance evidence (SOC2, audit logs) we can include with procurement

Copying our procurement contact — they’ll need SOW and pricing for internal approval.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, AI Research Lab
University of Oxford

---
Message 2
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Elena Martín <elena.martin@uni-ox.ac.uk>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline and isolated satellite enclave for campus cluster

Elena — great news, congrats on the grant. High-level response below and I attached a draft SOW and capacity matrix for your procurement team.

Quick summary:
1) Timeline: 6–8 weeks to provision and validate an on-prem satellite node if we can get the site checklist and access windows this week. Target staging: 2027-01-18 is feasible with accelerated procurement.
2) Term: We can propose an 18-month amendment to your existing contract with prorated pricing for the first partial period. We’ll outline the exact amendment in the SOW and provide an option matrix (12/18/24 months).
3) Compliance: SOC 2 Type II summary, retention and audit-log extracts are attached. For on-prem we’ll include a runbook for KMS/HSM integration and evidence checklist for your auditors.

Next steps:
- Can procurement confirm the PO cadence (single PO for SOW or phased POs)?
- Monica (CS) — can you confirm onboarding SLAs and any site-ops prechecks we need?
- Ben (Sales) — I’ll need a quick pricing recap and discount tier for education/academic pricing.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-oxford-satellite-v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); capacity-matrix-oxford.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

---
Message 3
From: Procurement Team <procurement@oxford-ai.ac.uk>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Martín <elena.martin@uni-ox.ac.uk>, s.khan@oxford-ai.ac.uk
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:23:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline and isolated satellite enclave for campus cluster

Hi Aditya / Ben,

Thanks for the draft SOW — procurement has two immediate asks to accelerate internal approvals:
1) We need an explicit termination/extension clause for the 18-month scenario and the proration method for the first invoice.
2) Provide a simple AML / vendor risk questionnaire and SOC2 attestation so our auditors can greenlight within 5 business days.
3) Can Redwood support a phased PO: initial PO for hardware staging + monthly ops invoices?

If we get those items by end of this week we can route to legal and finance for an expedited approval.

Regards,
Procurement Team
University of Oxford — AI Research Lab

---
Message 4
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Procurement Team <procurement@oxford-ai.ac.uk>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline and isolated satellite enclave for campus cluster

Hi — quick pricing and contracting options to meet the expedited timeline:

Option A — 18-month amendment (recommended for grants):
- Hardware + on-prem gateway + management: GBP 145,000 (one-time staging fee)
- Monthly ops (monitoring, maintenance, support): GBP 9,500/month
- Education discount applied: 18% off list for first 12 months
- Proration: invoice for staging fee on signing; monthly ops prorated from staging completion date.

Option B — 12-month rollover with accelerated provisioning:
- Staging fee: GBP 155,000
- Monthly ops: GBP 11,000/month
- Lower discount (8%)

We can accept a phased PO: PO1 for staging fee/hardware, PO2 for monthly ops. We will include the SOC2 attestation and vendor questionnaire in the DocuSign package.

Proposed rollout for Option A (if PO1 approved this week):
- Week 0–1: Site checklist + account provisioning
- Week 2–4: Hardware delivery & install (on-site windows required)
- Week 5–6: Integration, security validation, smoke tests
- Week 7: Staging sign-off and cutover to production

I’ll prepare a compact amendment and get it into DocuSign for signature; if procurement confirms PO cadence I’ll request the expedited approval path.

— Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-summary-oxford.pdf (PDF, 300KB)

---
Message 5
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Procurement Team <procurement@oxford-ai.ac.uk>, Elena Martín <elena.martin@uni-ox.ac.uk>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 16:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline and isolated satellite enclave for campus cluster

Thanks — procurment, if you can confirm PO1 for staging by EOD Friday we’ll trigger hardware procurement and reserve the install window. I’ve uploaded the compact amendment and the vendor questionnaire here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Oxford-AI/SOW.

I’ll route the DocuSign envelope (RDW-OPX-1492) with the 18-month amendment and SOC2 attestation. Once signed we’ll lock the install vendor and provide a weekly ops cadence for the first 8 weeks.

Action items summary:
- Procurement: confirm PO cadence and send PO1 by 2026-12-03 EOD
- Elena: confirm preferred install windows (weekdays 09:00–17:00 or weekend)
- Monica: create onboarding checklist and confirm KMS handoff
- Ben: finalize DocuSign envelope and include pricing-summary-oxford.pdf

Looking forward — we’ll prioritize Oxford on our next staging queue.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
